CustomField.description: Platform fan-out from schedule sets `Status='Expected'` — see [[gt-expected-status-default]]. FQS Gift Entry launcher defaults to `Paid` for retroactive data entry — see [[gt-status-default-paid]]. Direct-writing `Paid` on insert bypasses normal payment posting; use for seed/test only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where this gift is in the payment cycle. Choose Pending for gifts you've recorded financially but not yet received, Paid once the payment is in hand.
